mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (more than 1% quarter-over-quarter) indicates a weakening economy, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 dropped by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (more than 0.5% in a month) signals labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (more than 1% month-over-month) signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (more than 5% month-over-month) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (more than 0.2% month-over-month) signals a strengthening demand side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth rate below 2% YoY) coupled with a low federal funds rate (below 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real interest rates remain low.
regime_hint: low inflation, low interest rate environment
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth was below 2% and FEDFUNDS was below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in nonfarm payrolls (more than 200,000 jobs added per month for three consecutive months) signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS more than 1% month-over-month) signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.
